title: Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?
abstract: arXiv:2611.21155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: After a large language model (LLM) agent generates an artifact, users often send edit requests for it. This paper studies whether an LLM can anticipate these requests before they are sent. Such anticipation is useful in practice because it reduces the effort of user review and feedback. We formalize this task as edit recommendation and build EditRecBench, a benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLMs on this task, from real-world conversation logs in WildChat-4.8M. Through benchmarking and failure analysis, we identify a practical challenge that some cases are inherently difficult to predict in real-world settings. To address this, we introduce decision model-based gating to filter out cases where predictions are unlikely to be correct before they are presented to the user. Our trained model outperforms existing decision models and raises pass@5 among shown suggestions by 12--25 points at a gating threshold. Our code is available

translated_title: 编辑推荐：大语言模型能否预判用户的编辑请求，以及何时预判？
translated_abstract: 在大语言模型智能体生成作品之后，用户通常会对其发送编辑请求。本文研究大语言模型能否在这些请求被发送之前对其进行预判。这种预判能力在实践中非常有用，因为它可以减少用户审查和反馈的工作量。我们将这一任务形式化为“编辑推荐”，并基于 WildChat-4.8M 中的真实对话日志构建了 EditRecBench，一个用于评估大语言模型在该任务上表现的基准。通过基准测试和失败分析，我们发现了一个实际挑战：在真实场景中，有些案例本质上就难以预测。为解决这一问题，我们引入了基于决策模型的门控机制，在将预测结果展示给用户之前，过滤掉那些预测不太可能正确的情况。我们训练的模型优于现有的决策模型，在给定的门控阈值下，将所展示建议中的 pass@5 提升了 12–25 个百分点。我们的代码已公开。
tldr: 该论文提出“编辑推荐”任务及 EditRecBench 基准，研究大语言模型能否预判用户对生成结果的编辑请求，并通过基于决策模型的门控机制过滤掉难以预测的情况，将展示建议的 pass@5 提升 12–25 个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the edit recommendation task and the EditRecBench benchmark to study whether LLMs can anticipate users' edit requests, and proposes decision model-based gating to filter out hard-to-predict cases, raising pass@5 among shown suggestions by 12–25 points.
